title: Senior HR Shared Services Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Senior HR Shared Services Manager role at TechnipFMC

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Senior HR Shared Services Manager will lead and oversee the HR Shared Services operations across two countries in our South America region, including Brazil and Argentina. This role is pivotal in ensuring the seamless delivery of Payroll & Benefits Administration, Employee Services, Data Management, Reporting, and Talent Acquisition. The focus is to drive operational excellence by adhering to standards and SLAs, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and transformation. The position requires a strategic thinker with strong leadership skills, capable of managing a diverse team and collaborating with HR and business leaders to align HR services with organizational goals. The Senior HR Shared Services Manager will play a critical role in enhancing employee experience, optimizing HR processes, and ensuring compliance with employment laws and regulations across the region.

Job Description

  • Leadership and Management: Lead and manage the HR Shared Services team, ensuring high-quality service delivery and excellent customer service.
  • HR Operations: Oversee HR operations including Payroll & Benefits Administration, Employee Services, Data Management, Reporting, and Talent Acquisition.
  • Process Improvement: Implement HR policies and procedures to improve efficiency and effectiveness. Drive standardization, consolidation, automation, and process improvements.
  • Compliance: Ensure compliance with employment laws and regulations across all supported countries.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate with HR areas and business leaders to understand their needs and align HR services accordingly.
  • Performance Monitoring: Monitor HR metrics and use data to drive continuous improvement. Ensure adherence to standards and SLAs.
  • Transformation: Lead the identification, development, and execution of process improvement program initiatives, supporting the global strategic objectives of the Shared Services organization.
  • Employee Experience: Improve Employee overall experience with HR services by focusing our support on self‑services with proper standards.
  • Strategic Outsourcing: Keep and improve the support from our Global Business Services team for back office and transactional activities.
  • Technology Integration and Automation: Partner with HRIS to implement HR technology, maintain and enhance current systems.

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Bachelor/Master in HR related field, or MBA or Bachelor/Master in Technical field having HR related work experience
  • Solid leadership experience managing direct reports
  • Must be proficient in English
  • Knowledge, skills and experience in HR operations, HR Shared Services, project and system implementations and/or change management in complex organizations. In depth experience with payroll systems and vendors, ServiceNow, and HRIS systems such as Oracle and SuccessFactors.
  • Experience in managing multicultural and geographically dispersed teams.
  • Experience with process review and mapping.
  • Experience in implementing HR Shared Services and tiered service delivery models.
  • Availability to work in a Hybrid model (4 times a week in the office) and for travelling to other sites and countries.

Additional Skills

  • Outstanding strategic and operating skills
  • Excellent collaboration skills, and ability to work independently and systematically
  • Strong team player and able to delegate tasks and enable team‑members to perform
  • Able to “think outside the box” to influence concepts or solve problems.
  • Demonstrates the ability to communicate and engage with stakeholders at all levels in a succinct, organized, and professional compelling manner.
  • Ability to engage, motivate and develop teams and employees
  • Ability to work with remote management
  • Proven track record of driving change and influencing the organization across all levels through collaboration and working cross‑functionally to achieve goals.

Skills

  • Strategic Thinking and Execution
  • Communication
  • Analytical Skills
  • Team Leadership
  • Decision Making
  • Change Leadership

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

title: Well Control Instructor (Consultant)
description:
O Instrutor de Well Control é responsável por ministrar treinamentos de Controle de Poço de acordo com os padrões do IADC Well Sharp (níveis Introdutório, Driller e Supervisor – Superfície e Subsea). Este profissional deve assegurar que os participantes adquiram conhecimentos teóricos e práticos para operar com segurança em cenários de perfuração e controle de poços.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Ministrar aulas teóricas e práticas de Controle de Poço conforme o currículo oficial do IADC WellSharp.
  • Conduzir treinamentos práticos em simuladores, replicando cenários reais de controle de poço (kicks, shut-in, kill methods, etc.).
  • Aplicar avaliações e exames, garantindo conformidade com os requisitos de qualidade e integridade definidos pelo IADC.
  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho, registro de frequência e resultados dos alunos no sistema da IADC e nos controles internos.
  • Assegurar a atualização contínua dos materiais didáticos, simuladores e recursos de treinamento, em alinhamento com a versão vigente do programa.
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, contribuindo para a manutenção da acreditação do centro de treinamento.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de instrutores e suporte técnico no desenvolvimento e aprimoramento dos cursos.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Certificação: Instrutor aprovado pelo IADC WellSharp para ministrar cursos de Controle de Poço.
  • Conhecimento Técnico:
    • Métodos de controle de poço (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading)
    • Pressões de formação, influxo, hidráulica de poço, operações de cimentação e revestimento
    • Normas e boas práticas internacionais (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP)
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado (mandatório).

The Well Control Instructor is responsible for delivering Well Control training in accordance with IADC WellSharp standards (Introductory, Driller, and Supervisor levels – Surface and Subsea). This professional must ensure that participants acquire the theoretical knowledge and practical skills required to operate safely in drilling and well control scenarios.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver theoretical and practical Well Control classes in line with the official IADC WellSharp curriculum.
  • Conduct simulator-based training, replicating real well control scenarios (kicks, shut-in, kill methods, etc.).
  • Administer assessments and examinations, ensuring compliance with IADC quality and integrity requirements.
  • Prepare performance reports, attendance records, and student results within both the IADC system and internal controls.
  • Ensure continuous updating of training materials, simulators, and resources in alignment with the current program version.
  • Participate in internal and external audits, contributing to the maintenance of the training center’s accreditation.
  • Collaborate with the instructor team and technical support staff on the development and improvement of courses.

Qualifications

  • Certification: IADC WellSharp‑approved Instructor authorized to deliver Well Control courses.
  • Technical Knowledge:
    • Well control methods (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading)
    • Formation pressures, influx behavior, well hydraulics, casing and cementing operations
    • International standards and best practices (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP)
  • Languages: Advanced English (mandatory).

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks.

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.

What we are looking for in you

  • You have expertise in Python.
  • You have a strong understanding of the makeup of a modern GNU/Linux distribution.
  • You have a good understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation.
  • Experience working with container technology, such as Docker, Kubernetes and LXD.

  • Work with external open source and commercial projects to understand how we can better serve community needs.

PRIO is Brazil’s largest independent oil and gas company. We continuously seek process optimization and innovative solutions to reduce costs. All work is multidisciplinary and each challenge is unique.

We are looking for an Engenheiro de Operações de Embarcações to ensure availability, reliability, and compliance of vessels under your management, orchestrating personnel, suppliers, and processes to plan, execute, and continuously improve maintenance and asset performance. You will manage critical component modifications, align CAPEX/OPEX, operational schedules, and regulatory requirements (ANP, IBAMA, NR/ABNT, Class), sustaining company strategy and delivering subsea projects with performance in cost and Utilization Rate (Taxa de Utilização ).

Responsabilidades

  • Participar das discussões técnicas com o gestor da embarcação, de modo a auxiliar nas tomadas de decisões de manutenção, principalmente, nas que envolverem reparo e retorno;
  • Gerir junto ao gestor da embarcação as operações da unidade com foco na segurança e na disponibilidade operacional (uptime) do ativo através do planejamento estruturado;
  • Conduz os projetos e manutenções de alto impacto financeiro (CAPEX/OPEX) assegurando o cumprimento de escopo, prazos e qualidade pré definidos;
  • Atuar como interface com o time Subsea para converter a embarcação ao modo operacional requerido pelo projeto sempre que for pelo cliente, garantindo integrações técnicas seguras e eficazes;
  • Garantir junto ao gestor da embarcação que o planejamento financeiro de 5 anos seja mantido sempre atualizado (CAPEX e OPEX) sob gestão diligente de custos e escopo, garantindo visibilidade de viabilidade do ativo a longo prazo;
  • Realizar a Gestão mensal de custo da unidade com visibilidade de tendência (OPEX /CAPEX);
  • Acompanhar os serviços de terceirizadas garantindo eficiência e redução de custos necessários para operação da embarcação, bem como aprovar os Boletim de Medição referentes a serviços de bordo, mediante avaliação técnica do serviço entregues no ativo;
  • Acompanhar as auditorias, monitorar e garantir a execução dos planos de ação de não conformidades regulamentadas por agências governamentais (ANP, Ibama, Anvisa, etc), em especial dentro dos regulamentos de SGSO, SGSS, Medição Fiscal, CONAMA 393, Port State, órgão de classe e Normas Regulamentadoras;
  • Conduzir e orientar os registros das mudanças e adequações operacionais, sendo o facilitador do processo de Gestão de Mudança (MoC);
  • Identificar melhorias e revisar os procedimentos operacionais do ativo;
  • Avaliar e aprovar requisições e ordens de compra e interagir com Supply na contratação e tomada de decisão referente a fornecedores de serviços, equipamentos e materiais;
  • Gerir indicadores de performance do ativo (disponibilidade, confiabilidade, custos, prazo), promovendo ações corretivas quando necessário;
  • Conduzir reuniões periódicas com os envolvidos (suportes) para alinhar o planejamento e monitorar os avanços e serviços contratados;
  • Garantir adequado gerenciamento do ciclo de manutenção no ERP do ativo (planos, job cards, backlog, repostos críticos), garantindo execução on-time e atualização de históricos;
  • Liderar investigações de falhas (FRE/RCA), eliminar reincidências e retroalimentar planos de manutenção e procedimentos;
  • Definir critérios técnicos “compráveis” (especificações, HF codes, listas de materiais) e gerir riscos de obsolescência e intercambialidade;
  • Planejar janelas de porto (port calls) e gerenciar recursos necessários para rotina da embarcação junto ao cliente;
  • Gerir contratos e desempenho de fornecedores estratégicos (SLAs/KTIs), realizando expedições técnicas, auditorias e aplicação de lições aprendidas;
  • Desenvolver e monitorar KPIs (MTBF, MTTR, OTIF de manutenção, lead time de aquisição, disponibilidade do guindaste/sistemas), com dashboards e rotinas de performance operacional, de segurança e de manutenção;
  • Conduzir comunicação executiva (status, riscos, decisões de go/no-go), escalar bloqueios e alinhar prioridades com Operações/Subsea/Financeiro;
  • Garantir que a gestora da embarcação capacite toda a tripulação e equipes de apoio em treinamentos técnicos, procedimentos críticos, lições aprendidas;
  • Garantir que a gestora da embarcação planeje o estoque de sobressalentes críticos (níveis mínimos, cobertura, análise ABC) eliminando paradas por falta de materiais;
  • Responder a eventos críticos (falhas severas, incidentes), coordenar contingências e restabelecer a operação com segurança e celeridade;
  • Garantir aderência a políticas internas (alçadas, compliance, integridade, ESG) e participar de fóruns de governança de manutenção e projetos.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Curso superior em Engenharia ou certificação de Chefe de Máquinas;
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de embarcações de médio porte como PLSV e MPSV;
  • Experiência em gestão de manutenção com foco em confiabilidade, gestão de custo e geração de KPI’s;
  • Experiência em gestão de guindastes offshore com sistema compensador de heave;
  • Experiência em análise de falhas baseado em metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de melhoria contínua.

Processo Seletivo

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO? Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, a sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Benefícios e Ambiente

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst with strong FP&A experience and robust GAAP knowledge. This role requires someone who can work comfortably with complex financial models, support month‑end close activities, and drive high‑quality financial analysis for decision‑making. The ideal candidate is an Excel super‑user, experienced in building, managing, and reviewing large, integrated 3‑statement financial models. This person must also be able to lean into GAAP‑driven month‑end close review, assisting with accuracy, consistency, and quality checks across financial statements. This position is ideal for someone who has deep hands‑on FP&A experience and is comfortable working in fast‑paced environments where accuracy, timeliness, and attention to detail are critical.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Maintain, update, and improve large, complex 3‑statement Excel financial models, ensuring accuracy across income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statements.

  • Ensure all links, formulas, and assumptions in the model are correct, transparent, and fully auditable.
  • Serve as the primary owner of the model, performing ongoing quality reviews and consistency checks.
  • Support scenario analysis and sensitivity testing using the 3‑statement model.

GAAP Support & Month‑End Close Review

  • Assist with month‑end close review by applying strong GAAP knowledge to identify potential issues, inconsistencies, or inaccuracies.
  • Perform quality checks across financial statements to ensure GAAP compliance.
  • Collaborate with accounting partners to validate month‑end results and ensure the integrity of reporting.
  • Review month‑end reports and identify accounting adjustments that may be needed.
  • Support the team by ensuring month‑end timelines are met and that deliverables are accurate.

Excel Expertise

  • Act as an Excel super‑user, providing advanced modeling skills including formulas, functions, pivot tables, lookups, and error‑checking.
  • Ensure Excel files and financial models remain organized, consistent, and optimized for performance.
  • Create and maintain documentation of model structure, key assumptions, and calculation methodology.

General FP&A Responsibilities

  • Support core FP&A routines such as monthly reporting, forecasting, and budgeting, using the 3‑statement model as a foundation.
  • Assist with variance analysis by comparing actuals to forecast and identifying key drivers.
  • Provide clear and structured financial information to leadership.
  • Ensure financial analysis and reporting are delivered with precision and attention to detail.
  • Help maintain consistency in financial processes and standards within the FP&A function.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in FP&A or related financial analysis roles.
  • Strong GAAP knowledge and ability to apply it in practical review settings.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including expertise in managing large, integrated models.
  • Prior experience building and maintaining 3‑statement financial models.
  • Strong analytical mindset and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining high accuracy and meeting deadlines.

title: Senior Email Marketing Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior Manager, Retention—a seasoned CRM strategist and operator who brings equal parts creativity, technical depth, and leadership maturity to the table. This is not a maintenance role; it requires strategic ownership, hands‑on execution, and a bias for measurable impact. You’ll lead a team of lifecycle marketing experts to build sophisticated email, SMS, and loyalty programs that drive retention, increase LTV, and power sustained growth for a portfolio of fast‑scaling e‑commerce brands. This role demands sharp customer insight to turn data into strategy, comfort with complexity, and the ability to influence clients and internal stakeholders alike. You’ll report to our Director of Retention and collaborate closely with Performance, Creative, and Strategy teams to deliver cohesive, cross‑channel campaigns rooted in data and customer psychology.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for retention marketers who want to do the best work of their careers—operating at the intersection of personalization, loyalty, and performance‑driven innovation.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Mexico, Brazil, and Spain.

You Should Apply if this sounds like you:

You’re passionate about e‑commerce and digital marketing. You immersed in the world of direct‑to‑consumer growth marketing. We're looking for an expert Senior Manager, Retention to join our team! In this role, you will join a growing team within the Retention Marketing Department to strategically develop customized CRM and retention marketing strategies that help our clients grow and scale through email and SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs.

  • 7+ years of work experience in digital marketing.
  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e‑commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.
  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
  • You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
  • You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life:

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for select clients, working to develop best‑in‑class retention strategies. On a weekly basis, you will meet with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email and SMS programs.
  • Provide support and guidance to help Retention Specialists analyze data, develop winning retention strategies and create reports for clients happiness.
  • Project manage and delegate client tasks to your team, consisting of both specialists and designers. Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client.
  • Coordinate cross‑departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams to develop cohesive and creative campaigns that drive client growth.
  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
  • Execute on automation/flow logic set‑up, pop‑up builds, and app integrations.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Atuar no tratamento bucomaxilo-facial, conhecendo sobre trauma de face e ossos do crânio, corrigindo anomalias faciais como maxilar ou mandíbula muito grande, pequena ou desviada para os lados (assimetrias), cuidar dos enxertos para reposição de osso perdido ou atrofiado na boca (maxilar e mandíbula).

Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior completo em Odontologia

Pós Graduação completa em Cirurgia Buco Maxilo Facial

Registro ativo no conselho de classe

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função

description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Our mission is to reinvent the way companies manage their open source information systems - on public clouds and in their own data centers. To achieve that we are building a new community around Python opscode for open source applications, running on Kubernetes. We want to move all of Canonical and Ubuntu IS onto this new, open source codebase. We are confident that we can dramatically improve the experience of running complex business operations - and then we can help our customers embrace those new techniques and products. Traditionally, IS is an inward-facing operation. We would like to transform our IS team into an extension of the product engineering capability at Canonical. Our internal workloads are in many cases the same open source workloads that our customers want to operate. This team will productize those workloads for real-time automated operations on Kubernetes. This role is ideal for software engineers who enjoy Python, have a passion for distributed systems, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers. It is a role that requires rigor in both code and customer interactions. Our engineers are technically astute open source enthusiasts who are excited about cloud computing and are ready to join a global team charged with delivering world class services to our customers.

The role entails

  • Work in Python to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work across the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Learn to think rigorously about application and infrastructure reliability
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure
  • Simplify open source operations for our customers and open source community
  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code

  • Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights

  • Work from home with global travel once or twice a year for up to 2 weeks for events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You are experienced with Linux systems administration, package management, and operations
  • You have hands-on experience with at least one public cloud
  • You are familiar with Docker and Kubernetes
  • You are an experienced Python programmer and enjoy challenging projects
  • You understand the importance of reliable software and strive to design and code to that expectation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. title: Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction
description:
Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

YOUR MISSIONS

The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.

  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availiability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Problem-Solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

Canonical is hiring a Python Software Engineer to join the Certification team, who make the tools which enable us to know that a desktop, laptop, server or IoT device is working properly. We work at the interface of hardware and software, so the ideal candidate is a Python developer familiar with hardware.
The Certification team develops the tools needed to certify hardware as working with Ubuntu Core as well as Ubuntu Desktop and Server: design hardware which can be used to probe devices independently, and frameworks for software tests that check every aspect of Ubuntu on that hardware.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact for adoption of Linux across multiple device categories and industries. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities. This team is centered in EMEA time zones, and works with colleagues on related teams in both the Americas and APAC.
We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices.
Role description
We are looking for a self-motivated software engineer with experience developing in Python, to work on test automation tools or Linux based embedded hardware. This role offers an exciting opportunity to push the industry forward by enabling entirely new Linux based hardware testing capabilities, scaling up hardware certification efforts and allowing for deeper test coverage.
The role involves the development and maintenance of Canonical's open source certification tools, supporting the creation of hardware solutions for test automation, and automating our existing processes. We seek out continuous process and tooling improvements as part of expanding the certification test suites, ultimately to improve the quality of Linux experience felt by millions of Linux end users.
Key responsibilities

  • Maintain and develop new features to our Python based test automation tools like Checkbox, used by both in-house teams and industry partners.
  • Invent new ways to enable remote, automated testing.
  • Help build the software counterpart to in-house designed testing hardware to help test device enablement (graphics, hotplug, bluetooth, etc).
  • Write functional and performance tests to support hardware enablement and to protect from regressions.
  • Participate in meetings involving international travel 2-3 times per year.
Required Skills And Experience
  • Knowledge of Python programming language.
  • Quality oriented, pragmatic approach to software design and implementation.
  • Interest in test automation methodologies.
  • Previous experience working with Ubuntu or other Linux distributions.
  • Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team.
Desired Skills And Experience
  • Passion for tinkering: you are a maker.
  • Experience working in an agile environment.
  • Hardware testing experience, for example in the IoT space.
  • Familiarity with the C programming language.
What is Canonical?
Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, "the world's best free software platform". Our services help businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu.
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Job Description

The position

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.

A P&G é a maior empresa de bens de consumo embalados do mundo. Temos operações em mais de 75 países, com 65 marcas confiáveis que melhoram a vida de 5 bilhões de consumidores em todo o mundo. Isso traz muitas vantagens, incluindo a oportunidade para nossos funcionários desfrutarem de uma carreira diversificada e recompensadora, cheia de novos e empolgantes desafios.

Somos um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e valorizamos a diversidade em nossa empresa. Nossa missão de Igualdade e Inclusão é : "Todos valorizados. Todos incluídos. Todos desempenhando ao máximo."

Oferecemos desafios significativos desde o primeiro dia e treinamento eficaz e constante. Assim, aproveitamos as forças de nossos funcionários e os desenvolvemos para se tornarem líderes fenomenais, alcançando os mais altos níveis de gestão. Trabalhar conosco é a melhor oportunidade para fazer o que você ama, com desafios constantes e ser reconhecido pelos seus resultados. Mais do que isso, é a oportunidade ideal para nos ajudar a tocar e melhorar bilhões de vidas em nosso mundo.

Por mais de 175 anos, construímos algumas das marcas mais bem-sucedidas do mundo, incluindo Always®, Ariel®, Aussie®, Clearblue®, Downy®, Gillette®, Head and Shoulders®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene® e Vick®.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
O Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho deve garantir a integridade física e a saúde dos colaboradores próprios e terceiros, a conformidade legal e a prevenção de acidentes nas operações de transportes e logística da DeLuna, promovendo uma cultura de segurança alinhada aos valores e metas ESG da empresa.

Requisitos

  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho concluído. Registro/credenciamento profissional.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em operações de logística, armazenagem e transportes.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos:
    • NRs aplicáveis (NR-01, 04, 05, 06, 07, 10, 11, 12, 17, 20, 23, 26, 33, 35).
    • PGR, inventário de riscos, APR, permissões de trabalho, investigação de acidentes.
    • Segurança em armazéns, docas, empilhadeiras, amarração e movimentação de cargas.
    • Noções de saúde ocupacional e eSocial.
    • Combate a incêndio e brigada; plano de emergência e simulados.
    • Ergonomia aplicada a logística e operações frigorificadas.
  • Ferramentas:
    • Pacote Office/Google e ferramentas de checklists/auditorias digitais.
    • Sistemas de gestão de SST/SESMT e eSocial.
  • Habilitações/cursos desejáveis:
    • Instrutor NR-35/NR-33, brigada de incêndio, direção defensiva.
    • Noções de ISO 45001 e ISO 14001; primeiros socorros.
    • CNH B; disponibilidade para viagens.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Foco em segurança e cuidado ativo; presença em campo.
  • Comunicação clara e didática com públicos diversos.
  • Influência e negociação para gerenciamento de mudanças.
  • Organização, senso de urgência e disciplina na gestão de planos de ação.
  • Colaboração e postura consultiva com atendimento personalizado, alinhada aos valores DeLuna.
  • Integridade, confidencialidade e respeito às pessoas.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em operações e-commerce/last mile.
  • Experiência com gestão de transportadores terceiros e auditorias de clientes.
  • Participação em projetos de certificação e programs de cultura de segurança.

Responsabilidades e Atividades

1) Governança SST e Compliance

  • Atuar como integrante do SESMT conforme dimensionamento da NR-04.
  • Implementar e manter o PGR com inventário de riscos e plano de ação; apoiar as avaliações de exposição conforme NRs vigentes.
  • Apoiar a CIPA no dimensionamento, capacitação e cronograma anual; organizar SIPAT.
  • Gerir EPI/ EPC: especificação, distribuição, rastreabilidade, controle de vida útil e treinamentos.
  • Assegurarconformidade com NRs aplicáveis às operações DeLuna.
  • Acompanhar legislação aplicável ao transporte e logística e requisitos de clientes.

2) Operações de CDs, XPts e Transit Points

  • Realizar inspeções de rotina e emitir relatórios com planos de ação.
  • Validar layout seguro, sinalização, rotas de pedestres/empilhadeiras, proteção de estruturas, housekeeping.
  • Conduzir análises ergonômicas pontuais e propor melhorias.
  • Inspecionar sistemas de combate a incêndio e suportar brigada de incêndio;
  • Verificar condições de câmaras frias e EPIs térmicos em operações frigorificadas.

3) Transporte Rodoviário (FM/MM/LM, LH)

  • Apoiar programas de direção defensiva, análise de rotas críticas, gestão de fadiga e pausas.
  • Realizar inspeções de frota focadas em segurança.
  • Verificar documentação e treinamentos obrigatórios de motoristas e ajudantes conforme a legislação aplicável.
  • Conduzir DDS e blitz de segurança em pátios e pontos de apoio.
  • Investigar sinistros rodoviários e quase-acidentes, propondo ações corretivas e lições aprendidas.

4) Saúde Ocupacional e eSocial

  • Interface com PCMSO e Médico do Trabalho: exames admissionais, periódicos, retorno ao trabalho e mudança de função.
  • Apoiar os eventos do eSocial em conjunto com RH/DP e colaboradores.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de laudos e avaliações por profissionais legalmente habilitados, providenciando dados e acompanhando planos de ação.

5) Treinamentos, Cultura e Comunicação

  • Planejar, ministrar e/ou coordenar treinamentos obrigatórios e específicos.
  • Gerenciar a matriz de capacitação, controles de validade e reciclagens; garantir 100% de aderência.
  • Conduzir campanhas e comunicações de segurança, reforçando os valores e a cultura DeLuna.

6) Emergências e Preparação/Resposta

  • Manter plano de emergência atualizado: cenários em armazéns, câmaras frias, incêndio, vazamento de combustíveis, sinistros rodoviários.
  • Realizar simulados periódicos com brigada e times operacionais; alinhar com corpo de bombeiros e contratadas.
  • Garantir kits de emergência, fichas de segurança e contatos úteis disponíveis e atualizados.

7) Gestão de Terceiros e Fornecedores

  • Qualificar, auditar e acompanhar prestadores sob critérios de SST; verificar documentos, treinamentos e indicadores.
  • Incluir requisitos de SST em contratos e SLAs em parceria com Suprimentos e Jurídico.
  • Acompanhar execução de manutenção predial e de equipamentos por terceiros com Permissão de Trabalho quando aplicável.

8) ESG e Melhoria Contínua

  • Contribuir para metas ESG.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas/externas e requisitos de clientes;
  • Liderar investigação de incidentes com metodologia estruturada e garantir a eficácia das ações.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Realizar exames por imagens, tais como: raio x, tomografia, ressonância magnética, radiologia digital e outros, de acordo com as normas, diretrizes e procedimentos técnicos e operacionais estabelecidos, a fim de prestar apoio diagnóstico para tratamento de diversas patologias.

title: Senior Designer
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is looking for a Senior Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and dive deep into brand, performance, and product design. We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.

This role is for someone confident leading creative projects across a range of deliverables, from landing pages and retention flows to paid ads and digital branding, while staying grounded in strategy and results.

You’ll work closely with Retention Managers, Developers, and Designers to deliver polished work that balances brand and performance. You’ll lead initiatives independently while collaborating often, and communicate directly with clients, presenting designs, leading workshops, and managing approvals.

You’ll report to our Director of Creative and work directly with fast-growing brands where the stakes and opportunities are high. This role is designed for someone ready to take on more ownership, broaden their skills across disciplines, and grow quickly within a team that values both creativity and clarity.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone.

What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Marketing Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.

  • Create design systems based on a client’s brand guidelines to be used across multiple channels, ensuring consistency of a client’s brand identity, look, and feel.

  • Communicate with clients directly and present designs on calls, lead clients through workshopping, and obtain approvals while maintaining a strong working relationship.

  • Develop a deep understanding of what factors drive customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.

  • Design landing pages within Figma by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.

  • Collaborate with project managers and developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design updates, and more.

  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to the Design Director. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.

Requirements

Hard Skills:

  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)

  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong branding & identity, visual design, marketing design, and/or web design.

  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.

  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.

  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.

Soft Skills:

  • Highly creative individual who strives for detail-oriented design and can execute comfortably in a number of styles.

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and turn project requirements into compelling designs.

  • Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables.

  • Systematic thinker, who problem solves and time manages without heavy direction.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite

  • BFA or higher degree in Graphic Design or Fine Arts

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in-office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Vigilante
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Realiza patrulhamento preventivo, tanto interno quanto externo, nas dependências da empresa, com o objetivo de garantir a segurança de colaboradores, visitantes e do patrimônio da organização. Durante as rondas, é responsável por identificar comportamentos suspeitos e agir de forma preventiva para evitar furtos, danos materiais ou outras situações que representem risco à integridade do ambiente.

É responsável pelo controle de acesso de pessoas e veículos, verificando documentação, autorizando apenas o ingresso de indivíduos previamente identificados e garantindo que os procedimentos de entrada e saída sejam cumpridos de forma segura e organizada. Em situações de emergência, atua com agilidade, prestando os primeiros socorros quando necessário e acionando os órgãos competentes, como polícia, bombeiros ou atendimento médico.

Além disso, realiza o registro de ocorrências e incidentes em relatórios diários, detalhando as ações tomadas, horários, envolvidos e demais informações relevantes para o histórico e acompanhamento da segurança da empresa. Por fim, zela pelo cumprimento rigoroso de todas as normas e procedimentos de segurança estabelecidos, assegurando a ordem, o bom funcionamento das operações e a integridade do ambiente corporativo.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

  • Ensino médio completo (obrigatório).
  • Experiência anterior em áreas de segurança será um diferencial, porém não obrigatória.
  • ATA atualizada (exigida).
  • Facilidade no uso de sistemas de segurança, como câmeras de vigilância e alarmes.
  • Boa comunicação, tanto com colegas quanto com visitantes.
  • Conhecimento básico em segurança patrimonial e manuseio de sistemas de segurança e comunicação.
  • Postura proativa e vigilante.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager – Advanced Ads
description:
About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a Google Certified Publishing Partner and leading ad tech company that helps digital publishers maximize ad revenue through cutting‑edge technology and deep ad operations expertise. Our platform powers revenue growth for thousands of publishers worldwide—combining programmatic innovation, data intelligence, and transparent performance analytics.

We’re a fully remote, high‑impact team obsessed with empowering publishers through product‑led growth and continuous innovation.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Senior Growth Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Advanced Ads platform. This role is ideal for a data‑driven product leader with proven Product‑Led Growth (PLG) experience in SaaS or AdTech environments.

You’ll define and execute the growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization—using experimentation, analytics, and customer insights to turn product usage into sustained revenue growth. You’ll work at the intersection of data, technology, and customer experience, helping MonetizeMore scale through the product itself.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own growth metrics for the Advanced Ads platform (activation rate, expansion MRR, feature adoption, churn, lifetime value, etc.).
  • Drive Product‑Led Growth by designing onboarding flows, in‑product experiences, and self‑serve models that increase user activation and retention.
  • Identify and prioritize growth levers across the funnel—from self‑serve acquisition to expansion and upsell within existing publishers.
  • Lead data‑driven experimentation (A/B testing, funnel optimization, pricing tests) to accelerate growth.
  • Work closely with engineering, data science, and marketing to deliver features that increase user engagement and monetization.
  • Partner with GTM teams to create product‑driven campaigns that scale efficiently and reinforce PLG motions.
  • Collaborate with analytics and RevOps to measure performance, interpret product usage data, and turn insights into action.
  • Champion the user—understand publisher pain points, build empathy through data and research, and translate insights into high‑impact solutions.
  • Develop and evangelize growth frameworks that can be replicated across MonetizeMore’s product suite.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, including 2+ years focused on Growth or PLG in SaaS, AdTech, or marketplace environments.
  • Proven success scaling self‑serve or freemium products using Product‑Led Growth strategies.
  • Deep understanding of digital advertising technologies—programmatic, header bidding, ad exchanges, yield optimization, and ad fraud/IVT prevention.
  • Advanced analytical skills: building dashboards, defining KPIs, running A/B tests, interpreting behavioral data.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross‑functional teams in a distributed, remote environment.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management.
  • Bonus: experience with machine learning applications in AdTech, B2B SaaS monetization, or publisher‑side products.

What You’ll Get

  • The opportunity to own PLG strategy for a high‑impact AdTech platform used by global publishers.
  • Fully remote, asynchronous work culture with a results‑first mindset.
  • Collaborative, high‑performing peers in product, engineering, data science, and ad operations.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance‑based incentives and potential equity.

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).

  • Design and evolve the core platform (Kubernetes, Mesos, GPU scheduling/autoscaling, distributed compute)
  • Own the model platform: registry, experiment tracking, training orchestration, evaluation, serving, and monitoring
  • Build the Golden Path: reference repos, a scaffold CLI, opinionated CI/CD pipelines, runtime contracts (health/metrics/tracing/SLOs), high‑performance clients, circuit breakers and other production‑ready defaults

MLOps Excellence

  • Operate a secure, multi‑tenant model registry and training platform with standardized experiment/evaluation harnesses
  • Provide turnkey serving patterns (online + batch), drift/quality monitoring, and rollback playbooks
  • Integrate public/open‑source AI capabilities as managed platform services with cost and data‑governance guardrails

Team Management

  • Run the squad: roadmap/prioritization, delivery, mentoring, and high engineering standards
  • Partner with product engineering (Zyte API, Scrapy Cloud), Prod Ops, and Security on adoption and rollout plans
  • Mentor the team and foster a platform‑thinking mindset

Ownership Areas

  • Container orchestration (Kubernetes/Knative), GPU provisioning & autoscaling, environment & secret management
  • Operators, sidecars, and internal SDKs/libraries (Go/Rust/Python/Java) that enforce the golden path contract
  • Model platform: registry, experiment tracking, training orchestration, evaluation framework, serving infra, model monitoring
  • Observability: logging/metrics/tracing pipelines
  • Billing pipeline: metering/events/cost tracking abstractions
  • Golden Path: Java, Python, ML templates + CI/CD blueprints + docs + scaffold CLI
  • Reliability enablement (SRE practices), cost governance, supply‑chain security (SBOM, image signing)

Qualifications

Required
  • 5+ years experience building distributed systems; 3+ years in MLOps/ML platform engineering (or equivalent impact)
  • Knowledge of Linux/OS internals (process model, cgroups/namespaces), networking (TCP/IP, HTTP/2), concurrency, and performance profiling

  • Experience with GPU infrastructure (scheduling, containerization, optimization)
  • Track record of designing and operating model platforms (registry, training, serving, monitoring) in production
  • Demonstrated success leading technical teams and implementing organization‑wide platform solutions
Preferred
  • Streaming & workflows: Kafka plus Argo/Temporal/Airflow or equivalents
  • eBPF‑based observability, perf tooling, or io_uring experience
  • Cost optimization for ML/AI; multi‑tenant quotas and fairness
  • Hands‑on experience authoring Golden Paths (service chassis/templates, CI/CD blueprints, CLI scaffolds)
  • SRE practices (SLIs/SLOs, incident management)

Benefits

  • Become part of a self‑motivated, progressive, multi‑cultural team

1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital‑first businesses—including neo‑banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1GLOBAL, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures

  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
