description:
Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager (Americas only)

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager to lead a regionally‑focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.

Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos (Americas, EMEA, or APAC). You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans a few time zones from you.

Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission‑critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.

Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands‑on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best‑of‑breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.

This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low‑level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business‑focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback

  • Extensive Linux experience – Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study

Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote‑first, diverse, distributed company.

Benefits

The Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant will work collaboratively to build and establish the overall QA process with a focus on SAP landscapes and model based test automation through TOSCA. Responsibilities for this position also include mentoring QA personnel on SAP testing methodology, TOSCA frameworks, automation strategies, and other technical aspects.   • Consult with the customer on the design and implementation of comprehensive Test Activities across SAP modules and TOSCA automation that satisfy Test Objectives and ensure sustainable product Quality throughout the SDLC

  • Participate in the deployment of SAP enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and major implementations

  • Act as a key point of contact for all QA aspects of SAP releases and TOSCA automation delivery while managing customer expectations

  • Leadership skills with the ability to mentor QA professionals in SAP testing and TOSCA automation
  • Ability to work independently, meet SAP project timelines, and adapt to changing requirements
  • Experience with SDLC including SAP business planning, data analysis, functional requirements analysis, and application design
  • Strong decision making and problem-solving skills related to SAP functional and TOSCA automation challenges
  • Ability to evaluate information from multiple SAP sources, assess risks, prioritize user needs, and design appropriate test solutions
  • Experience working in Agile and Waterfall development environments
  • Knowledge of large-scale SAP deployments, implementations, support, and upgrade projects

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Systems, or Computer Science
  • 7+ years of experience in Software Development and Quality Assurance including User Acceptance Testing, Functional Testing, Performance Testing, Manual and Automated Testing. UAT experience is required
  • 3-6 years of SAP Functional Testing experience
  • 2-4 years of hands-on TOSCA automation experience
  • ISTQB Certification preferred

If your experience or qualifications are similar to our ideal candidate, please consider applying. Experience comes in many forms, skills may be transferable, but passion for your career cannot be substituted. At TTC, we recognize the value of diversity and the unique perspectives it brings. We encourage everyone to apply.

title: Condition Based Monitoring Engineer
description:
About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonisation and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we share our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

You support the effective management and optimisation of rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs by monitoring and analysing machinery conditions. Your role is crucial in ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency through continuous condition‑based monitoring, data analysis, and collaboration with various teams. You play a key role in troubleshooting, maintenance planning, and guiding the technical team in making informed decisions to prevent failures, enhance equipment lifespan, and support safe and efficient operations.

Responsibilities

  • You support Machinery Engineers and the Maintenance Team in managing the Condition‑Based Program for rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs, including compressors, turbines, blowers, pumps, gearboxes, and motors.
  • You review and monitor rotating equipment conditions using vibration data, lube oil results, and other critical operating data (e.g., pressures, temperatures, flows, loads, efficiencies) to assess equipment health.
  • Manage the Vibration & Oil Analysis Database and support issuance of recommendations, consolidating inputs from third parties for the Offshore crew.
  • You are responsible for input actions in the Computerised Maintenance Management System.
  • You follow up on recommendations execution and effectiveness.
  • You perform continuous vibration analysis on equipment with installed Machinery Monitoring Systems (e.g., Bently Nevada System 1).
  • You set up pre‑warnings and alerts to proactively identify potential issues and necessary actions.
  • You collaborate with Operations and Maintenance Personnel, Technical Support Team, and Region Planners to prioritise repairs for identified equipment deficiencies.
  • You assist in troubleshooting by analysing vibration data and other key machine parameters.
  • You provide vibration and oil analysis history to support root‑cause analysis efforts.
  • You offer guidance to the Technical Support Team and System Leads on machinery conditions during task risk assessments and gate reviews (e.g., after major repairs or life‑extension evaluations).
  • You identify and justify the purchase of major predictive equipment spare parts.
  • You provide technical assistance for root‑cause analysis related to ICSS failures and recommend remedial actions.

Education

  • High level of safety awareness and good sense of economics.
  • Offshore survival and medical desirable/required.

Experience

  • Advanced knowledge in the field of Machinery Condition monitoring.
  • Good knowledge of Bently Nevada System 1 or ADRE.
  • Rotor dynamic knowledge.
  • Oil & Gas Experience – FPSO experience preferred.

O Gerente de Vendas será responsável por liderar a equipe comercial , definir estratégias agressivas de crescimento e garantir resultados consistentes em margem e receita . Seu papel é construir autoridade no mercado , dominar a concorrência e transformar previsões em números reais de faturamento.

Responsabilidades

Objetivo da Posição

O Gerente de Vendas será responsável por liderar a equipe comercial , definir estratégias agressivas de crescimento e garantir resultados consistentes em margem e receita . Seu papel é construir autoridade no mercado , dominar a concorrência e transformar previsões em números reais de faturamento.

Responsabilidades
  • Definir, executar e ajustar o plano estratégico de vendas alinhado aos objetivos da empresa.
  • Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe comercial, garantindo disciplina no uso de roteiros, metas e indicadores de performance.
  • Construir a tríplice confiança com clientes: confiança no produto, no vendedor e na decisão de compra.
  • Elaborar e otimizar ofertas irresistíveis que aumentem o valor percebido e reduzam o risco para o cliente.
  • Usar técnicas avançadas de negociação: perguntas estratégicas, “ponte ao futuro” e quebra de objeções .
  • Monitorar resultados, pipeline e previsões comerciais, tomando decisões rápidas para corrigir desvios.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico do cliente , garantindo recorrência e fidelização de longo prazo.
Indicadores de Sucesso
  • Atingimento e superação de metas mensais e trimestrais.
  • Crescimento percentual em receita e margem.
  • Redução do ciclo de vendas.
  • Retenção e satisfação de clientes-chave.
  • Desenvolvimento de novos líderes dentro da equipe.
Perfil do Candidato
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de equipes comerciais e vendas de alto valor.
  • Habilidade para negociar em cenários complexos , com múltiplos decisores.
  • Mentalidade de líder e estrategista , não apenas executor.
  • Capacidade de motivar e disciplinar times , blindando-os contra distrações e baixa performance.
  • Domínio de técnicas de vendas consultivas e habilidade de construir rapport genuíno.
  • Foco em lucro, margem e posicionamento de mercado .
Diferenciais
  • Histórico de crescimento acelerado em empresas B2B ou B2C.
  • Experiência em estruturar ofertas de alto impacto (ex: “resultado ou dinheiro de volta”).
  • Vivência em programas de treinamento e mentoria de vendas .
  • Capacidade de transformar objeções em novas oportunidades de fechamento .
Remuneração & Benefícios
  • Salário fixo competitivo.
  • Comissão agressiva baseada em performance.
  • Bônus por superação de metas.
  • Resumo: Esta vaga não é para quem busca estabilidade e rotina previsível. É para quem quer liderar com estratégia, cortar desculpas, cobrar resultados e colocar a empresa no topo do mercado .

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer II
description:
15 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

The Company You’ll Join
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.
Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.
Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.
For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.
The Problems You'll Solve
At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.
As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.
You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.
You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.
The Team You'll Work With
The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.
About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn
Please note: Please submit your resume in English. This role will be hybrid in our Rio office.
Disclosures
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.
  • Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details.

description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente. O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimentos sobre asset allocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Morar no Rio de Janeiro, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atender aos principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Triagem inicial

Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais

Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento

Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança

Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial

Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação

Entrevista focada em cultura

Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta

Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes. Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities, movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managing the entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un‑/loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health‑and‑safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post‑tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Purpose

You support the effective management and optimization of rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs by monitoring and analyzing machinery conditions. Your role is crucial in ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency through continuous condition‑based monitoring, data analysis, and collaboration with various teams. You play a key role in troubleshooting, maintenance planning, and guiding the technical team in making informed decisions to prevent failures, enhance equipment lifespan, and support safe and efficient operations.

Responsibilities

  • You support Machinery Engineers and the Maintenance Team in managing the Condition‑Based Program for rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs, including compressors, turbines, blowers, pumps, gearboxes, and motors.
  • You review and monitor rotating equipment conditions using vibration data, lube oil results, and other critical operating data (e.g., pressures, temperatures, flows, loads, efficiencies) to assess equipment health.
  • Manage the Vibration & Oil Analysis Database and support the issuance of recommendations, consolidating inputs from third parties for the Offshore crew.
  • You are responsible for input actions in the Computerized Maintenance Management System.
  • You should follow up on recommendations execution and effectiveness.
  • You perform continuous vibration analysis on equipment with installed Machinery Monitoring Systems (e.g., Bently Nevada System 1).
  • You set up pre‑warnings and alerts to proactively identify potential issues and necessary actions.
  • You collaborate with Operations and Maintenance Personnel, Technical Support Team, and Region Planners to prioritize repairs for identified equipment deficiencies.
  • You assist in troubleshooting by analyzing vibration data and other key machine parameters.
  • You provide vibration and oil analysis history to support root cause analysis efforts.
  • You offer guidance to the Technical Support Team and System Leads on machinery conditions during task risk assessments and gate reviews (e.g., after major repairs or life extension evaluations).
  • You identify and justify the purchase of major predictive equipment spare parts.
  • You provide technical assistance for root cause analysis related to ICSS failures and recommend remedial actions.

Education

  • Minimum ISO 18436‑2 Cat III certification.
  • High level of safety awareness and good sense of economics.
  • Offshore survival and medical desirable/required.

Experience

  • Rotor dynamic knowledge.

  • Able to work autonomously and in multi‑disciplinary teams.

  • Ability to travel internationally (short term), including offshore.

description:
Enterprise Customer Success Manager

Join the Canonical team as an Enterprise Customer Success Manager. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include world‑leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing. We are hiring a Customer Success Manager to help reduce risk and churn, facilitate adoption of new products, and support expansion within existing accounts.

Responsibilities

  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes, including Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications, and many others.
  • Elaborate and coordinate complex projects in interaction with developers, IT managers, and decision makers from various industries.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering, and Support to develop and deliver engagement plans that fulfil the customer’s objectives.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers in a specific geographic region and identify growth opportunities or renewal risks in coordination with Sales.
  • Experience running a disciplined, weekly customer and business review process with cross‑functional teams, identifying and prioritising blockers, and driving resolution through corporate product and engineering teams.
  • Serve as a customer advocate internally and influence Canonical product roadmaps, websites, documentation, processes, and people to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Support customers through reactive ticket requests.
  • Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch‑points and activities.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of the following topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.
  • Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery of customer‑related projects.
  • A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies.
  • Proficiency (written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese, along with an excellent command of English, is highly appreciated.

Additional Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira, and CRMs is a big plus.

Benefits

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review and performance‑driven annual bonus or commission.
  • Recognition rewards and annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity, paternity leave, and a Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

Other Information

Location: Remote. Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level. Employment type: Full‑time. Job function: Other.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit globally and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence: to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal‑opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
#LI-Remote

Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma equipe referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos autonomia e proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. A colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nosso objetivo é enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, melhorando sua vida através do que entregamos.

O time de Banking:

A estrutura de Product Platforms | Banking tem o propósito de prover serviços bancários para todos os segmentos da StoneCo, auxiliando no engajamento da base de clientes, no aumento do LTV e na redução de churn, tornando-se uma das principais fontes de receita da companhia através dos times de Core Transacional, Cartões, Baas, BPNA, Banking Processes e Open Finance.

Nosso objetivo é desenvolver soluções que garantam que, após a venda, o empreendedor possa receber e usar seu dinheiro, pagando seus funcionários, fornecedores e tributos, além de administrar seus recursos para prosperar.

Atuamos em todo o ciclo de vida do cliente, conectando suas vendas à gestão de sua empresa, apresentando e ampliando nossa gama de serviços, garantindo que sejamos seu provedor financeiro único.

Como é ser um(a) Software Engineer Senior - Mobile Android:

Buscamos um(a) profissional especializado(a) em desenvolvimento mobile com foco em Kotlin para integrar nosso time de tecnologia. Você contribuirá para o desenvolvimento e otimização de estruturas financeiras dentro do aplicativo Stone, criando soluções inovadoras e escaláveis.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência com Kotlin e Android nativo;
  • Experiência com Github;
  • Experiência com REST;
  • Testes unitários;
  • Injeção de dependência;
  • Programação reativa (e.g., Coroutines Flow, RxJava).

O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Experiência com Jetpack Compose;
  • Gradle;
  • CI/CD;
  • Publicação na Play Store;
  • Ferramentas de métricas e marketing (Firebase, Google Analytics, etc.);
  • Produtos digitais financeiros ou apps de larga escala;
  • Liderança ou mentoria;
  • Design Patterns e arquiteturas de software (MVVM, MVI, MVP);
  • Técnicas de segurança móvel (autenticação, criptografia, certificate pinning);
  • Contribuição em projetos Open Source.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO: O Gerente Geral Comercial será responsável por liderar e gerenciar todos os canais de vendas da empresa, incluindo vendas internas, externas, revendas e parcerias. Seu principal objetivo é otimizar os resultados comerciais, impulsionando as vendas, garantindo a execução das estratégias de mercado, e o alinhamento de todos os times comerciais. • Planejamento Estratégico: Criar e implementar planos de ação para aumentar a performance de vendas em todos os canais, com foco na expansão e otimização dos resultados comerciais.
• Análise de Desempenho Comercial: Monitorar o desempenho de cada canal de vendas, identificando tendências, oportunidades e pontos de melhoria. Utilizar essas informações para ajustar as estratégias de vendas e maximizar a participação de mercado.
• Acompanhamento de Indicadores: Analisar e acompanhar semanalmente os relatórios de vendas, desempenho e KPIs, fazendo ajustes necessários para garantir o atingimento das metas estabelecidas.
• Desenvolvimento de Novas Parcerias: Identificar novas oportunidades de parcerias estratégicas que possam fortalecer a rede de canais de vendas e ampliar a capilaridade do mercado.
• Pesquisa de Mercado: Realizar pesquisas contínuas sobre o mercado, concorrência e tendências, com o objetivo de fornecer insights e propostas de ação para a área comercial.
• Treinamento e Desenvolvimento: Planejar e coordenar treinamentos para gerentes de vendas, supervisores e equipes comerciais, visando aprimorar as competências técnicas e comportamentais.
• Gestão de Relacionamentos: Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos sólidos com parceiros comerciais, clientes-chave e outros stakeholders, promovendo o crescimento e a fidelização.

• Coordenação de Projetos Comerciais: Gerenciar projetos comerciais estratégicos, desde a concepção até a execução, garantindo a implementação eficaz e os resultados esperados.
• Ajustes e Melhoria Contínua: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos comerciais, utilizando feedbacks de equipe, clientes e mercado para refinar as práticas de vendas e aumentar a produtividade.
• Gestão do Orçamento Comercial: Controlar e gerenciar os custos comerciais, garantindo que as ações sejam realizadas dentro do orçamento previsto e que haja uma boa alocação de recursos.
• Análise de Concorrência: Acompanhar de perto as estratégias de concorrentes e realizar ajustes nas estratégias internas para manter ou aumentar a competitividade da empresa.

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027").

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament. This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Your profile

Your profile

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital‑first businesses—including neo‑banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As a Network Engineering member in the Voice and Services functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analysing and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the voice systems under the responsibility of the functional area. You will prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio, define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area, and participate and support the other functional areas in cross‑functional projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end‑to‑end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLDs, LLDs, WOs, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environment. Understanding of end‑to‑end system testing requirements
  • Follow‑up and define quality and performance indicators
  • Capacity and performance analysis, reporting and improvement solution definition
  • Service & resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross‑team processes
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of NGN based networks, including MSS/MGW, HLR/HSS, SBC
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining voice interconnects, SIP/RTP based
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Knowledge about VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience with SMS service configuration and routing
  • IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes including P/S/I‑CSCF, Application Servers
  • IMS Protocol Interfaces – Gm Interface, ISC interface, Sh Interface, Cx, SOAP/XML, etc
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online). Knowledge and experience of OCS and, Ro, Ro+, Ga and Bp interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocol
  • Knowledge and experience with Signaling Gateways and protocols including SS7, SIGTRAN, MAP and CAMEL
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency is mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle and Ribbon IMS products

Benefits

  • CLT contract – enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses – to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card – R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica – 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave – 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance – provided to mothers with children under 3 years old – R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities : Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure : Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team : From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly be exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment : Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development : Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience : Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture : Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude : Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer; we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

About the company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

#LI-Hybrid

About the team/role

You will be part of a team that manages the operations of an entire city. In this role, you can influence the operational outcomes for the whole city and use your creativity to help merchants run their food delivery businesses more effectively, enabling users to discover and enjoy their favorite meals.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Responsible for merchant quantity, activity, and healthy business performance.
  • Signing & Planning: Analyze merchant performance, identify growth opportunities across multiple dimensions, and guide the BD team to efficiently acquire high-value merchants.
  • Operations Policy: Use policy adjustments to drive merchants toward high-quality information presentation, resolve merchant issues, boost merchant activity and per-merchant yield, and ensure healthy platform operation.
  • Merchant Marketing: Develop merchant marketing strategies, mobilize merchant subsidy resources, and coordinate with the BD team to drive implementation.
  • Data analysis: Analyze data, gain insights from merchant-related data, and drive operational decisions based on the data analysis results.
  • Targets & Budget: Plan budget allocation, set recommended targets, establish cross-functional alignment, and evaluate and review strategy effectiveness.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with the Delivery side to balance supply and demand, and optimize delivery experience.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher; 5+ years of experience; prior experience in Internet merchant/partner strategy operations or business analytics preferred.
  • Excellent logical and structured thinking; strong ability to synthesize and distill insights; data-aware with solid data analysis skills.
  • Integrity, strong communication and collaboration skills, self-driven.
  • English proficiency to work as a working language.
  • International/global business experience.
  • Proficiency in SQL/EXCEL.
  • Extroverted/Outgoing personality friendly for cross-team collaboration.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win‑win Collaboration. Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You

  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)

  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).

  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify pattern and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands‑on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament. This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play‑off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027). The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections, and the escalation of risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the ongoing development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On‑going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast‑related overlay, as well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on‑site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio de Janeiro FIFA office. Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre‑planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play‑off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

Your Profile

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).

We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer with deep experience in AWS, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, and cloud architecture to lead the modernization, expansion, and operational excellence of our cloud ecosystem.   • Support Windows endpoint management (Chef, Ansible, or AWS Systems Manager)
  • Document infrastructure and deliver training to internal teams
  • Build S3‑based storage and lifecycle rules for large datasets

Must‑Have

  • 5+ years of DevOps experience in AWS environments
  • Strong experience with AWS CDK (Python or C#)
  • Hands‑on experience with GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Experience with Aurora PostgreSQL, Redshift, SQL Server on EC2, EventBridge, IAM, API Gateway, Amplify, Step Functions, Glue
  • Experience with Chef, Ansible, or AWS Systems Manager
  • Familiarity with OpenSearch, Datadog, or ELK for logging

Nice to Have

  • Experience with event‑driven architectures

  • Knowledge of S3 lifecycle management & large data handling
  • Strong documentation & training delivery skills

description:
MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA E-MULTI - AP 4.0 – SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS). Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião‑dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo das ações da atenção básica bem como qualificar a situação de saúde da população. Apoiar as equipes de saúde na família na realização do manejo das situações de saúde mental e risco psicossocial na atenção básica, propiciando, ainda, o acesso ao sistema de saúde e à reinserção social.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Especialização ou Residência em Psiquiatria com RQE;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Preencher os requisitos da Resolução SMS 4871 de 13 de Abril de 2021 , a saber:
  • RESOLVE: Art. 1º Define como requisito obrigatório para a atuação na equipe multiprofissional do Núcleo de Apoio à Saúde da Família e Atenção Básica (NASF-AB) ao menos 2 (dois) dos critérios abaixo:
    • Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação direta no saúde da família ou no núcleo de apoio à saúde da família.
    • Ter no mínimo 5 (cinco) anos de experiência profissional na área da saúde.
    • Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação em um centro de atenção psicossocial (CAPS).
    • Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação stricto sensu em saúde da família, saúde pública ou saúde coletiva.
    • Certificado de conclusão de residência ou pós-graduação lato sensu em saúde.
    • Título de especialista reconhecido pela associação médica brasileira (AMB).
    • Ter participado de 3 (três) atividades de atualização científica e/ou acadêmica nas áreas: Saúde da Família, Medicina, Saúde Pública e Saúde Coletiva (congressos, seminários, workshop, capacitações em cursos presenciais ou à distância) nos últimos dois anos antes da contratação.

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

O Kumon é uma multinacional japonesa euma das maiores redes de educação do mundo; estamos presente em mais de 50 países, somando mais de 4 milhões de alunos. No Brasil, nossas quase 1500 unidades atendem todas as regiões e com isso, nos consolidamos também como a maior rede de franquiano segmento de educação do país.

O método Kumon maximiza a capacidade dos alunos, descobre qual é o ponto ideal de estudo para cada ume fornece aos mesmos,material didático eficaz; o consultor de campo atua diretamente com a rede franqueada no intuito de contribuir para o desenvolvimento de nossas unidades e consequentemente dos alunos.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições de um Consultor de Campo Kumon:

Realização de Visitas e Treinamentos Específicos às Unidades Franqueadas

  • Apoiar e desenvolver orientadores e franqueados, promovendo integração e capacitação contínua.
  • Adaptar a abordagem conforme o perfil e o momento de cada franqueado, assegurando a correta aplicação do Método Kumon.
  • Planejar e realizar treinamentos direcionados às necessidades específicas das unidades, fortalecendo a autonomia e a qualidade da operação.

Elaboração de Relatórios e Planos de Acompanhamento

  • Elaborar planos de ação e acompanhamento com base nos principais indicadores (matrículas, IC6, TMP).
  • Preparar relatórios de visitas e manter informações atualizadas para as áreas de suporte e gestores.
  • Acompanhar resultados e propor estratégias de melhoria contínua.
  • Apoiar a implementação de ferramentas digitais e garantir a organização de agendas e processos.
  • Contribuir com planos e iniciativas para fortalecer a marca Kumon.

Coordenação e Realização de Reuniões

  • Coordenar e apresentar reuniões regionais e gerais com franqueados, garantindo comunicação clara e integração entre as unidades.
  • Dar suporte na condução de reuniões com pais de alunos e eventos de fortalecimento da marca.
  • Atuar como ponte entre matriz e unidades, mantendo o fluxo de informações consistente e transparente.

Consultorias Personalizadas

  • Oferecer consultorias alinhadas às necessidades e ao perfil de cada unidade franqueada.
  • Acompanhar e avaliar a eficácia das orientações, analisando resultados e propondo planos de desenvolvimento específicos.
  • Promover a troca de boas práticas e o fortalecimento da rede de franqueados.

Análise de Dados

  • Gerenciar e analisar dados para acompanhar indicadores de desempenho das unidades.
  • Interpretar resultados e propor ações estratégicas que apoiem o crescimento sustentável e a melhoria dos indicadores-chave.
  • Utilizar ferramentas digitais para monitoramento e suporte à tomada de decisão.

Satisfação dos Franqueados, Alunos e Pais

  • Contribuir para a satisfação e fidelização dos franqueados, alunos e pais, por meio de uma atuação próxima, empática e orientada a resultados.
  • Apoiar eventos e ações que promovam o engajamento e o fortalecimento da marca Kumon nas regiões.

Para continuarmos aumentando ainda mais o valor do método Kumon e assim, atingirmos o maior número de crianças possível, buscamos profissionais com as seguintes características:

  • Ensino Superior completo (graduação completa);
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Inglês (desejável);
  • Experiênciacom franquias, áreas de negócios, área comercial e/ou consultorias

(atuação na área da Educação será considerado um diferencial);

  • Experiência com redes sociais e tecnologia em geral;
  • Disponibilidade para viagem;
  • Residir em Rio de Janeiro e/ou região
  • Identificação com a área daeducação, método e filosofia da empresa.

Nós, do Kumon, valorizamos todos os esforços para construir um ambiente e uma cultura nos quais todos os colaboradores tenham a garantia de uma vida com tranquilidade; por isso oferecemos benefícios visando o bem estar e também o desenvolvimento de colaboradores e familiares. Explicamos um pouco mais com a descrição abaixo.

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Assistência Médica: Plano apartamento sem custo para o colaborador e com taxa fixa para dependentes diretos (não é co-participação).
  • Assistência Odontológica: Opcional.
  • Auxílio Creche: Para colaboradores com filhos até 5 anos.

  • Vale Refeição.

  • PLR: Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (anual).

Educação:

  • Subvenção Educação: Subsídio para apoiar o desenvolvimento profissional (respeitando o valor limite).
  • Estudo Gratuito do Material Didático de Todas as Disciplinas do Kumon: Todos os colaboradores poderão realizar o estudo do material didático do Kumon de todas as disciplinas, utilizando 30 minutos de sua jornada de trabalho diária.
  • Reembolso para Estudo pelo Método Kumon: Disponível em unidades franqueadas para colaboradores e dependentes legais.
